questions: Are there any other characters allowed in the input string besides spaces and the three defined note tokens ('o', 'o|', '.|')?
Should the function handle multiple consecutive spaces or leading/trailing spaces in the input string?
Is the input guaranteed to be non-empty? The test case with empty string suggests empty input is possible, but should it return an empty list or raise an error?
Are the note tokens always separated by exactly one space, as in the examples, or could other whitespace (tabs, newlines) be used?
Is the order of the output list strictly the left-to-right order of tokens in the input string?
Should the function validate that the input string is a valid sequence of known notes, or silently ignore unrecognized substrings?
Can note tokens appear concatenated without separators (e.g., 'o.o|') or must they always be separated by spaces?
Is the mapping of note to beats fixed as given, or could there be other note types with different beat values?
